description: Object /launch (API.md §9): the preparation of lw run and of a debug launch as task-streamed methods; the protocol-10 prepare_run request stays as prepare_run's v0 alias. The client runs the program of the launch spec in its own process, or hands the debug spec to its debugger. device_log lands in a later step. Step 5t (API.md §9.4, §4.3) adds the task-streamed build of a launch target and force on prepare_run / prepare_debug with their handlers (part B): the registry refuses a schema method without a handler.

prepare_run.description: Build (unless no_build), deploy and resolve the launch of the profile's target or launch configuration; the task result carries the launch spec, or device for a program that runs on a device in the client.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

target.description: The target or launch configuration name.

project.description: The project the target belongs to.

kind.description: Which kind of name target is (--target / --launch); absent: either.

quiet.description: --print / --dry-run: the build's lines go to stderr.

prefix.description: The client wraps the program (--prefix): a device target is refused.

verbose.description: -v, as for loomworks.Build/1 build (API.md §9.1): for the preparation's dependency build and deploy steps (    copy ... /     up to date ...).

force.description: The answer to the artifact-conflict question (spec 5.9), which the client asks before the call as before a build: build over another profile's output artifact.

build_scope.description: What the preparation builds before resolving: profile (the default) builds the profile and runs its deploy steps, as lw run does; target runs the launch flow instead -- the launch's dependencies, the pre-build deploy steps, the launch target's own unit, the post-build deploy steps -- each build taking only its unit's build-directory lock. Neither builds or deploys with no_build.

result.description: The preparation's end: the launch spec on success.

device.description: The program runs on a device: the client runs it (API.md §9.1).

prepare_debug.description: Prepare a debug launch: the steps of prepare_run in the same order with the same gates and lines, ending with the debug spec the client hands to its debugger. A device target, or a target found foreign by its kit or by probing its artifact, ends the task nonzero with the in-process refusal (before the build when the kit tells, otherwise once the build probed it, and before any deploy); it is never declined for it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

target.description: The target or launch configuration name.

project.description: The project the target belongs to.

kind.description: Which kind of name target is (--target / --launch); absent: either.

Neither builds or deploys with no_build.

result.description: The preparation's end: the debug spec on success.

build.description: Build a launch target as the editor's in-process launch build does (API.md §9.4; step 5t): the target resolved as prepare_run resolves it, then its dependencies, the pre-build deploy steps and its own unit, in that order, as one task whose steps (Common/1 TaskMeta.steps, Tasks/1 step) follow each phase. No artifact probe, post-build deploy or launch resolution — except that a device target (step 5n) ends with its post-build deploy steps; its install and launch are Devices/1's.

target.description: The target or launch configuration name.

project.description: The project the target belongs to.

kind.description: Which kind of name target is (--target / --launch); absent: either.

force.description: The answer to the artifact-conflict question (spec 5.9), asked by the client before the call: build over another profile's output artifact.

result.description: The build's end: exit_code 0 when every step succeeded, else the first failing step's failure line.
